reviews.title: Day 80 recommendation
reviews.text: This app is actually been awesome because weirdly I followed through and I’m on day 80. A couple suggestions. First of all, it would be so cool if there was an adjacent squat app or a couple other exercise apps or options that follow the exact same app layout. Actually, it would be better if they’re in the same app because then you could do a certain amount of push-ups and then you’d need to complete your squats or situps or something afterwards? Also, I wish there was a feature that would make you have to do sets of push-ups throughout the day. For example, your apps would lock again in the afternoon and you’d have to do another set to unlock them again. Otherwise five stars it’s amazing. I just hope you guys keep developing it at some point thank you for not making us pay and not bugging us to get the premium feature

reviews.title: An app that finally made me consistent
reviews.text: I saw this app on Reddit and decided to give it a try because I always tell myself I'm going to do push-ups every day but then I don't follow through. Today makes a little over a month that I've had the app, and I haven't missed a day. I'm now doing 25% more push-ups in one set than I was when I first started, so I can tell I’m making progress. It also helps me feel good about myself, so I'm glad I found this app. Definitely give it a try, especially if consistency is an issue for you.
